record.question: A government servant is convicted and sentenced to imprisonment exceeding forty-eight hours, but is not immediately dismissed, removed or compulsorily retired. Under Rule 10, the deemed suspension takes effect:
options: from the date on which the disciplinary authority decides to act on the conviction
from the date on which the appellate court confirms the conviction
from the forty-ninth hour after the prison authority reports the conviction to the Department
from the date of conviction, with the forty-eight hours computed from the commencement of imprisonment
